record.paper_title: Open Problems in Computability Theory and Descriptive Set Theory
record.original_question: For every Borel ideal I on ω, does there exist a closed I-MED, that is, a closed maximal eventually different family relative to I?

evidence.quote: Let I be an ideal on ω. We can define I-MED analogous to the above definition. A family ε ⊆ ωω is called an I-MED if: (i) For all f ̸= g ∈ ε, {n : f(n) = g(n)} ∈ I and (ii) ∀h ∈ ωω∃f ∈ ε {n : f(n) = g(n)} ∈ I+.
Problem 48. For all Borel I, is there a closed I-MED?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let ω denote the set of natural numbers and ω^ω the set of functions from ω to ω. Let I be an ideal on ω containing all finite sets, and write I^+ = P(ω) \ I for its coideal. A family ε ⊆ ω^ω is called an I-maximal eventually different family (I-MED) if:
(i) for all distinct f, g ∈ ε, the set {n ∈ ω : f(n) = g(n)} belongs to I, and
(ii) for every h ∈ ω^ω there exists f ∈ ε such that {n ∈ ω : f(n) = h(n)} ∈ I^+.

Equip ω^ω with the product (Baire space) topology. Question: for every Borel ideal I on ω, does there exist an I-MED family ε ⊆ ω^ω that is closed in ω^ω?
artifact.category_tag: Descriptive set theory and maximal eventually different families
artifact.status_search_result: For the classical case I = Fin, a closed (in fact lightface Π⁰₁) maximal eventually different family in ω^ω is known to exist (Schrittesser, building on Horowitz–Shelah's Borel MED construction). However, no published resolution of the relativized question for arbitrary Borel ideals I was located, and the problem appears in a recent open-problems compilation. The general I-MED version thus appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: A closed maximal eventually different family
status_evidence.snippet: Schrittesser constructs a closed (Π⁰₁) maximal eventually different family in ω^ω, settling the case I = Fin.
status_evidence.claim: The Fin-case admits a closed MED family, but the Borel-ideal generalization is not addressed.

status_evidence.title: On Horowitz and Shelah's Borel maximal eventually different family
status_evidence.snippet: Improvement of the Horowitz–Shelah Borel MED construction to a lightface Π⁰₁ MED family.
status_evidence.claim: Closed MED families exist for the standard (Fin) case; no analogous result for general Borel ideals I is given.
